I'm only 19, but there's still a huge difference between the toys I had and toys now. I can barely pay for new clothes or my classes, but kids can get a mini media player that plays mp3s and dvds? This comercial (aparently from when J.C Pennys was just called "Pennys") is a good look back on the history of toy comercials, the brands aren't mentioned which is something no TV ad would omit today, and the whole "white room" theame seems wonderfully outdated. This commercial touts the availability of toys at Penny's in general, without spending too much time on any specific one. After seeing the scenes for this commercial. I was pretty pumped to see this ad, but it's just ok. I'm not too sure what the purpose for the narrator's escalating voice, but oh well. My favorite toy here would be the slot car racing set that can set off a flying top.
